ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَۙ ۝۱ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۝۲ مٰلِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِؕ ۝۳ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِيْنُؕ ۝۴ اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمَۙ ۝۵ صِرَاطَ الَّذِيْنَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْۙ ۵ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّيْنَ ۝۷ ـ سَبْعًا
tr: Al-Ḥamdu li ‘lLāhi Rabbi ‘l-`Ālamin (1) A’r-Raḥmāni ‘r-Raḥim (2) Māliki Yawmi ‘d-Dīn (3) Iyyāka na`budu wa iyyāka nasta`īn (4) Ihdina ‘ṣ-Ṣirāṭa ‘l-Mustaqīm. Ṣirāṭa ‘lladhina an`amta `alayhim (6), ghayri ‘l-maghḍūbi `alayhim wa la ‘ḍ-ḍā ‘l-līn (7)
en: In the name of Allah, The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful

Praise Allah, Lord of the Worlds.(1) The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful.(2) Owner of the Day of Doctrine {Judgement}(3) You Alone we worship and You Alone we beseech(4) Show us the straight path(5) The path of those you favour (6), not those with wrath upon them nor those astray
blocks.review: After عَلَيْهِمْۙ a small unringed superscript ۵ is printed (not a medallion).
